name: Cranberry Walnut Fudge
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Place butter, sour cream, and sugar into a saucepan. Put the saucepan on a stove and cook for 15 minutes over medium heat.
Remove from heat and add vanilla extract, marshmallow creme, and white chocolate chips.
Using a mixing spoon, stir until the mixture is smooth.
Fold in the walnuts and cranberries.
Pour the mixture into an 8x8-inch baking pan.
Put the pan into the refrigerator to cool for 1 hour.
